rationale: The short thesis remains intact: price is below both the 5-min VWAP ($30.66) and session VWAP ($32.29), the bounce to $30.48 was rejected on the heaviest volume of the sequence (22.5k), and TENB is showing sharp relative weakness against a +0.93% SPY day.
